headline: BD merger swells revenue; GAAP loss, guidance raised
summary_short: Revenue rose 113% year over year to $1,645M as the newly consolidated Biosciences and Diagnostic Solutions business added $817M, while legacy organic revenue grew 7%; GAAP EPS swung to a $1.39 loss on acquisition charges even as adjusted EPS hit $3.05, and guidance was raised.
summary_long: Total revenue of $1,645M (+113% y/y) includes the Biosciences and Diagnostic Solutions business acquired from Becton Dickinson on February 9, 2026, which contributed $817M; underlying organic revenue grew 7% as reported and 9% in constant currency, led by ASD instrument and consumables growth. GAAP diluted EPS was a $1.39 loss on $244M of purchased-intangibles amortization and a $155M inventory step-up tied to the deal; adjusted EPS rose 3% y/y to $3.05, at the high end of guidance. Waters raised full-year guidance: organic constant-currency revenue growth to 7-9%, acquired-business revenue to about $3.045B, and adjusted EPS to $14.45-$14.65. Cash was $539M; long-term debt rose to $4.886B funding the acquisition.

drivers.explanation: CEO said the company executed "ahead of guidance across all four divisions," with organic growth broadening across customer segments and the newly acquired businesses growing mid-single-digits in their first full quarter; the company raised every component of full-year guidance.

Growth is the sum of the Biosciences and Diagnostic Solutions acquisition ($817M, consolidated since February 9, 2026) plus organic revenue growth of 7% reported / 9% constant currency, driven by 8% ASD instrument growth and double-digit chemistry consumables growth.

GAAP diluted loss reflects acquisition-related purchase accounting charges: $244M of purchased-intangibles amortization and a $155M inventory/fixed-asset fair-value step-up; adjusted EPS excludes these and grew 3% y/y to $3.05.

Swing to an operating loss is explained by the same purchase-accounting charges plus $49M of restructuring costs and $37M of acquisition-related integration costs layered onto the newly consolidated cost base.
Operating cash flow rose to $200M (from $41M) on the enlarged combined business; financing activities used $123M mostly for scheduled debt payments, netting to a $76M cash increase for the quarter.
Debt financing facilities were secured to fund the Becton Dickinson Biosciences and Diagnostic Solutions acquisition, which closed February 9, 2026 and added the balance now carried on the books.
